name: Sagiyama Isamu
source: The titular protagonist of the hidden PSP-exclusive "Sagiyama" scenario. An aspiring screenwriter. After graduating from university, he becomes an assistant director to get to know the industry, but the stress of the job makes him want to quit on the first day. He's recently been interested in a high school girl named [url=/c141283]Fukamachi Yui[/url].
